verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-meem-saad
Kitaabun unzila ilayka falaa yakun fee sadrika harajun minhu litundhira bihi wa dhikraa lilmu'mineen
Ittabi'oo maa unzila ilaykum min rabbikum wa laa tattabi'oo min doonihi awliyaa'a qaleelan maa tadhakkaroon
Wa kam min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa fajaa'ahaa ba'sunaa bayaatan aw hum qaa'iloon
Famaa kaana da'waahum idh jaa'ahum ba'sunaa illaa an qaaloo innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
Falanas'alannal-ladheena ursila ilayhim wa lanas'alannal-mursaleen
Falanaqussanna alayhim bi-ilmin wa maa kunnaa ghaa'ibeen
Wal-waznu yawma'idhin al-haqqu faman thaqulat mawaazeenuhu fa-ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wa man khaffat mawaazeenuhu fa-ulaa'ikal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum bimaa kaanoo bi-aayaatinaa yazlimoon
Wa laqad makkannaakum fil-ardi wa ja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayisha qaleelan maa tashkuroon
Wa laqad khalaqnaakum thumma sawwarnaakum thumma qulnaa lilmalaa'ikati usjudoo li'dama fasajadoo illaa ibleesa lam yakun minas-saajideen
Qaala maa mana'aka allaa tasjuda idh amartuka qaala anaa khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min naarin wa khalaqtahu min teen
Qaala fahbit minhaa famaa yakoonu laka an tatakabbara feehaa fakhruj innaka minas-saaghireen
Qaala anzirnee ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaala innaka minal-munzareen
Qaala fabimaa aghwaytanee la-aq'udanna lahum siraatakal-mustaqeem
Thumma la-aatiyannahum min bayni aydeehim wa min khalfihim wa an aymaanihim wa an shamaa'ilihim wa laa tajidu aktharahum shaakireen
Qaalakh-ruj minhaa madh'ooman madhooran laman tabi'aka minhum la-amla'anna jahannama minkum ajma'een
Wa yaa'aadamu uskun anta wa zawjukal-jannata fakulaa min haythu shi'tumaa wa laa taqrabaa haadhihish-shajarata fatakoonaa minaz-zaalimeen

Fawaswasa lahumash-shaytaanu liyubdiya lahumaa maa wooriya anhumaa min saw'aatihimaa wa qaala maa nahaakumaa rabbukumaa an haadhihish-shajarati illaa an takoonaa malakayni aw takoonaa minal-khaalideen
Wa qaasamahumaa innee lakumaa laminan-naasiheen

Fadallaahumaa bighuroorin falammaa dhaaqash-shajarata badat lahumaa saw'aatuhumaa wa tafiqaa yakhsifaani alayhimaa min waraqil-jannati wa naadaahumaa rabbuhumaa alam anhakumaa an tilkumash-shajarati wa aqul lakumaa innash-shaytaana lakumaa aduwwun mubeen
Qaalaa rabbanaa zalamnaa anfusanaa wa in lam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen
Qaalah-bitoo ba'dukum liba'din aduwwun wa lakum fil-ardi mustaqarrun wa mataa'un ilaa heen
Qaala feehaa tahyawna wa feehaa tamootoona wa minhaa tukhrajoon
Yaa banee aadama qad anzalnaa alaykum libaasan yuwaaree saw'aatikum wa reeshan wa libaasut-taqwaa dhaalika khayrun dhaalika min aayaa ti Allaahi la-allahum yadhdhakkaroon

Yaa banee aadama laa yaftinannakumush-shaytaanu kamaa akhraja abawaykum minal-jannati yanzi'u anhumaa libaasahumaa liyuriyahumaa saw'aatihimaa innahu yaraakum huwa wa qabeeluhu min haythu laa tarawnahum innaa ja'alnash-shayaa teena awliyaa a lilladheena laa yu'minoon
Wa idhaa fa-aloo faahishatan qaaloo wajadnaa alayhaa aabaa'anaa Wallaahu amaranaa bihaa qul innallaaha laa ya'muru bil-fahshaa'i ataqooloona alaa Allaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qul amara rabbee bil-qisti wa aqeemoo wujoohakum inda kulli masjidin wad'oohu mukhliseena lahud-deena kamaa bada'akum ta'oodoon
Fareeqan hadaa wa fareeqan haqqa alayhimud-dalaalatu innahumu ittakhadhush-shayaateena awliyaa'a min doonillaahi wa yahsaboona annahum muhtadoon
Yaa banee aadama khudhoo zeenatakum inda kulli masjidin wa kuloo washraboo wa laa tusrifoo innahu laa yuhibbul-musrifeen

Qul man harrama zeenata Allaahil-latee akhraja li-ibaadihi wat-tayyibaati minar-rizqi qul hiya lilladheena aamanoo fil-hayaatid-dunyaa khaalisatan yawmal-qiyaamati kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmin ya'lamoon

Qul innamaa harrama rabbiyal-fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wa maa batana wal-ithma wal-baghya bighayril-haqqi wa an tushrikoo Billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sultaanan wa an taqooloo alaa Allaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa likulli ummatin ajalun fa-idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum laa yasta'khiroona saa'atan wa laa yastaqdimoon
Yaa banee aadama immaa ya'tiyannakum rusulun minkum yaqussoona alaykum aayaa tee famani ittaqaa wa aslaha falaa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wastakbaroo anhaa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon

Faman azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bi-aayaatihi ulaa'ika yanaaluhum naseebuhum minal-kitaabi hattaa idhaa jaa'athum rusulunaa yatawaffawnahum qaaloo ayna maa kuntum tad'oona min doonillaahi qaaloo dalloo annaa wa shahidoo alaa anfusihim annahum kaanoo kaafireen

Qaalad-khuloo fee umamin qad khalat min qablikum minal-jinni wal-insi fin-naari kullamaa dakhalat ummatun la-anat ukhtahaa hattaa idhad-daarakoo feehaa jamee'an qaalat ukhraahum li'wlaahum rabbanaa haa'ulaa'i adalloonaa fa-aatihim adhaaban di'fan minan-naari qaala likullin di'fun wa laakin laa ta'lamoon
Wa qaalat oolaahum li'khraahum famaa kaana lakum alaynaa min fadlin fadhooqul-adhaaba bimaa kuntum taksiboon
Innal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wastakbaroo anhaa laa tufattahu lahum abwaabus-samaa'i wa laa yadkhuloonal-jannata hattaa yalijal-jamalu fee sammil-khiyaati wa kadhalika najzil-mujrimeen
Lahum min jahannama mihaadun wa min fawqihim ghawaashin wa kadhalika najziz-zaalimeen
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon

Wa naza'naa maa fee sudoorihim min ghillin tajree min tahtihimul-anhaaru wa qaalul-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee hadaanaa lihadhaa wa maa kunnaa linahtadiya lawlaa an hadaanaa Allaahu laqad jaa'at rusulu rabbinaa bil-haqqi wa noodoo an tilkumul-jannatu oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

Wa naadaa ashaabul-jannati ashaaban-naari an qad wajadnaa maa wa-adanaa rabbunaa haqqan fahal wajadtum maa wa-ada rabbukum haqqan qaaloo na'am fa-adhdhana mu'uadhdhinun baynahum an la'natu Allaahi alaz-zaalimeen
Al-ladheena yasuddoona an sabeelillaahi wa yabghoonahaa iwajan wa hum bil-aakhirati kaafiroon
Wa baynahumaa hijaabun wa alal-a'raafi rijaalun ya'rifoona kullan biseemaahum wa naadaw ashaabal-jannati an salaamun alaykum lam yadkhuloohaa wa hum yatma'oon
Wa idhaa surifat absaaruhum tilqaa'a ashaabin-naari qaaloo rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa ma'al-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wa naadaa ashaabul-a'raafi rijaalan ya'rifoonahum biseemaahum qaaloo maa aghnaa ankum jam'ukum wa maa kuntum tastakbiroon
Ahaa'uulaa al-ladheena aqsamtum laa yanaaluhumu Allaahu birahmatin udkhulul-jannata laa khawfun alaykum wa laa antum tahzanoon
Wa naadaa ashaabun-naari ashaabal-jannati an afeedoo alaynaa minal-maa'i aw mimmaa razaqakumu Allaahu qaaloo innallaaha harramahumaa alal-kaafireen
Al-ladheena ittakhadhoo deenahum lahwan wa la-iban wa gharrathumul-hayaatud-dunyaa fal-yawma nansaahum kamaa nasoo liqaa'a yawmihim haadhaa wa maa kaanoo bi-aayaatinaa yajhadoon
Wa laqad ji'naahum bikitaabin fassalnaahu alaa ilmin hudan wa rahmatan liqawmin yu'minoon

Hal yanzuroona illaa ta'weelahu yawma ya'tee ta'weeluhu yaqoolul-ladheena nasoohu min qablu qad jaa'at rusulu rabbinaa bil-haqqi fahal lanaa min shufa'aa'a fayashfa'oo lanaa aw nuraddu fana'mala ghayral-ladhee kunnaa na'malu qad khasiroo anfusahum wa dalla anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon

Inna rabbakumu Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin thumma istawaa alal-arshi yughshil-laylan-nahaara yatlubuhu hatheethan wash-shamsa wal-qamara wan-nujooma musakhkharaatin bi-amrihi alaa lahul-khalqu wal-amru tabaaraka Allaahu rabbul-aalameen
Ud'oo rabbakum tadarru'an wa khufyatan innahu laa yuhibbul-mu'tadeen
Wa laa tufsidoo fil-ardi ba'da islaahihaa wad'oohu khawfan wa tama'an inna rahmata Allaahi qareebun minal-muhsineen

Wa huwal-ladhee yursilur-riyaaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi hattaa idhaa aqallat sahaaban thiqaalan suqnaahu libaladin mayyitin fa-anzalnaa bihil-maa'a fa-akhrajnaa bihi min kullith-thamaraati kadhaalika nukhrijul-mawtaa la-allakum tadhakkaroon
Wal-baladut-tayyibu yakhruju nabaatuhu bi-idhni rabbihi wal-ladhee khabutha laa yakhruju illaa nakidan kadhaalika nusarriful-aayaati liqawmin yashkuroon
Laqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihi faqaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu innee akhaafu alaykum adhaaba yawmin azeem
Qaalal-mala'u min qawmihi innaa lanaraaka fee dalaalin mubeen
Qaala yaa qawmi laysa bee dalaalatun wa laakinnee rasoolun min rabbil-aalameen
Uballighukum risaalaati rabbee wa ansahu lakum wa a'lamu mina Allaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Awa'ajibtum an jaa'akum dhikrun min rabbikum alaa rajulin minkum liyundhirakum wa litattaqoo wa la-allakum turhamoon
Fakadhdhaboohu fa-anjaynaahu wal-ladheena ma'ahu fil-fulki wa aghraqnal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa innahum kaanoo qawman ameen
Wa ilaa aadin akhaahum hoodan qaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu afalaa tattaqoon
Qaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihi innaa lanaraaka fee safaahatin wa innaa lanazunnuka minal-kaadhibeen
Qaala yaa qawmi laysa bee safaahatun wa laakinnee rasoolun min rabbil-aalameen
Uballighukum risaalaati rabbee wa anaa lakum naasihun ameen

Awa'ajibtum an jaa'akum dhikrun min rabbikum alaa rajulin minkum liyundhirakum wadhkuroo idh ja'alakum khulafaa'a min ba'di qawmi noohin wa zaadakum fil-khalqi bastatan fadhkuroo aalaa'a Allaahi la-allakum tuflihoon
Qaaloo aji'tanaa lina'buda Allaaha wahdahu wa nadhara maa kaana ya'budu aabaa'uunaa fa'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen

Qaala qad waqa'a alaykum min rabbikum rijsun wa ghadabun atujaadiloonanee fee asmaa'in sammaytumoohaa antum wa aabaa'uukum maa nazzala Allaahu bihaa min sultaanin fantaziroo innee ma'akum minal-muntazireen
Fa-anjaynaahu wal-ladheena ma'ahu birahmatin minnaa wa qata'naa daabiral-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wa maa kaanoo mu'mineen

Wa ilaa thamooda akhaahum saalihan qaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu qad jaa'atkum bayyinatun min rabbikum haadhihi naaqatu Allaahi lakum aayatan fadharoohaa ta'kul fee ardi Allaahi wa laa tamassoohaa bisoo'in faya'khudhakum adhaabun aleem

Wadhkuroo idh ja'alakum khulafaa'a min ba'di aadin wa bawwa'akum fil-ardi tattakhidhoona min suhoolihaa qusooran wa tanhitoonal-jibaala buyootan fadhkuroo aalaa'a Allaahi wa laa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
Qaalal-mala'ul-ladheena istakbaroo min qawmihi lilladheena ustud'ifoo liman aamana minhum ata'lamoona anna saalihan mursalun min rabbihi qaaloo innaa bimaa ursila bihi mu'minoon
Qaalal-ladheena istakbaroo innaa billadhee aamantum bihi kaafiroon
Fa-aqarun-naaqata wa ataw an amri rabbihim wa qaaloo yaa saalihu i'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa in kunta minal-mursaleen
Fa-akhadhathumur-rajfatu fa-asbahoo fee daarihim jaathimeen
Fatawallaa anhum wa qaala yaa qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risaalata rabbee wa nasahtu lakum wa laakin laa tuhibboonan-naasiheen
Wa lootan idh qaala liqawmihi ata'toonal-faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min ahadin minal-aalameen
Innakum lata'toonar-rijaala shahwatan min doonin-nisaa bal antum qawmun musrifoon
Wa maa kaana jawaaba qawmihi illaa an qaaloo akhrijoohum min qaryatikum innahum unaasun yatatahharoon
Fa-anjaynaahu wa ahlahu illam-ra'atahu kaanat minal-ghaabireen
Wa amtarnaa alayhim mataran fanzur kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mujrimeen

Wa ilaa madyana akhaahum shu'ayban qaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu qad jaa'atkum bayyinatun min rabbikum fa-awful-kayla wal-meezaana wa laa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa ahum wa laa tufsidoo fil-ardi ba'da islaahihaa dhaalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
Wa laa taq'udoo bikulli siraatin too'idoona wa tasuddoona an sabeelillaahi man aamana bihi wa tabghoonahaa iwajan wadhkuroo idh kuntum qaleelan fakaththarakum wanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mufsideen
Wa in kaana taa'ifatun minkum aamanoo billadhee ursiltu bihi wa taa'ifatun lam yu'minoo fasbiroo hattaa yahkuma Allaahu baynanaa wa huwa khayrul-haakimeen
Qaalal-mala'ul-ladheena istakbaroo min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka yaa shu'aybu wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'aka min qaryatinaa aw lata'oodunna fee millatinaa qaala awalaw kunnaa kaariheen

Qadif-taraynaa alaa Allaahi kadhiban in udnaa fee millatikum ba'da idh najjaanaa Allaahu minhaa wa maa yakoonu lanaa an na'ooda feehaa illaa an yashaa'a Allaahu rabbunaa wasi'a rabbunaa kulla shay'in ilman alaa Allaahi tawakkalnaa rabbanaa iftah baynanaa wa bayna qawminaa bil-haqqi wa anta khayrul-faatiheen
Wa qaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihi la-ini ittaba'tum shu'ayban innakum idhan lakhaasiroon
Fa-akhadhathumur-rajfatu fa-asbahoo fee daarihim jaathimeen
Al-ladheena kadhdhaboo shu'ayban ka'an lam yaghnaw feehal-ladheena kadhdhaboo shu'ayban kaanoo humul-khaasireen
Fatawallaa anhum wa qaala yaa qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risaalaati rabbee wa nasahtu lakum fakayfa aasaa alaa qawmin kaafireen
Wa maa arsalnaa fee qaryatin min nabiyyin illaa akhadhnaa ahlahaa bil-ba'saa'i wad-darraa'i la-allahum yaddarra'oon
Thumma baddalnaa makaanas-sayyi'atil-hasanata hattaa afaw wa qaaloo qad massa aabaa'anad-darraa'u was-sarraa'u fa-akhadhnaahum baghtatan wa hum laa yash'uroon
Wa law anna ahlal-quraa aamanoo wattaqaw lafatahnaa alayhim barakaatin minas-samaa'i wal-ardi wa laakin kadhdhaboo fa-akhadhnaahum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Afa'amina ahlul-quraa an ya'tiyahum ba'sunaa bayaatan wa hum naa'imoon
Awa amina ahlul-quraa an ya'tiyahum ba'sunaa duhan wa hum yal-aboon
Afa'aminoo makra Allaahi falaa ya'manu makra Allaahi illal-qawmul-khaasiroon
Awalam yahdi lilladheena yarithoonal-arda min ba'di ahlihaa an law nashaa'u asabnaahum bidhunoobihim wa natba'u alaa quloobihim fahum laa yasma'oon
Tilkal-quraa naqussu alayka min anbaa'ihaa wa laqad jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati famaa kaanoo liyu'minoo bimaa kadhdhaboo min qablu kadhaalika yatba'u Allaahu alaa quloobil-kaafireen
Wa maa wajadnaa li'ktharihim min ahdin wa in wajadnaa aktharahum lafaasiqeen
Thumma ba'athnaa min ba'dihim moosaa bi-aayaatinaa ilaa fir'awna wa mala'ihi fazalamoo bihaa fanzur kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mufsideen
Wa qaala moosaa yaa fir'awnu innee rasoolun min rabbil-aalameen
Haqeequn alaa an laa aqoola alaa Allaahi illal-haqqa qad ji'tukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum fa-arsil ma'ee banee israa'eel
Qaala in kunta ji'ta bi-aayatin fa'ti bihaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Fa-alqaa asaahu fa-idhaa hiya thu'baanun mubeen
Wa naza'a yadahu fa-idhaa hiya baydaa'u lin-naazireen
Qaalal-mala'u min qawmi fir'awna inna haadhaa lasaahirun aleem
Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum famaadhaa ta'muroon
Qaaloo arjihi wa akhaahu wa arsil fil-madaa'ini haashireen
Ya'tooka bikulli saahirin aleem
Wa jaa'as-saharatu fir'awna qaaloo inna lanaa la-ajran in kunnaa nahnul-ghaalibeen
Qaala na'am wa innakum laminal-muqarrabeen
Qaaloo yaa moosaa immaa an tulqiya wa immaa an nakoona nahnul-mulqeen
Qaala alqoo falammaa alqaw saharoo a'yunan-naasi wastarhaboohum wa jaa'oo bisihrin azeem
Wa awhaynaa ilaa moosaa an alqi asaaka fa-idhaa hiya talqafu maa ya'fikoon
Fawaqa'al-haqqu wa batala maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Faghuliboo hunaalika wanqalaboo saaghireen
Wa ulqiyas-saharatu saajideen
Qaaloo aamannaa birabbil-aalameen
Rabbi moosaa wa haaroon
Qaala fir'awnu aamantum bihi qabla an aadhana lakum inna haadhaa lamakrun makartumoohu fil-madeenati litukhrijoo minhaa ahlahaa fasawfa ta'lamoon
La-uqatti'anna aydiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafin thumma la-usallibannakum ajma'een
Qaaloo innaa ilaa rabbinaa munqaliboon
Wa maa tanqimu minnaa illaa an aamannaa bi-aayaati rabbinaa lammaa jaa'atnaa rabbanaa afrigh alaynaa sabran wa tawaffanaa muslimeen
Wa qaalal-mala'u min qawmi fir'awna atadharu moosaa wa qawmahu liyufsidoo fil-ardi wa yadharaka wa aalihataka qaala sanuqattilu abnaa'ahum wa nastahyee nisaa'ahum wa innaa fawqahum qaahiroon
Qaala moosaa liqawmihi ista'eenoo Billaahi wasbiroo innal-arda Lillaahi yoorithuhaa man yashaa'u min ibaadihi wal-aaqibatu lilmuttaqeen
Qaaloo oodheenaa min qabli an ta'tiyanaa wa min ba'di maa ji'tanaa qaala asaa rabbukum an yuhlika aduwwakum wa yastakhlifakum fil-ardi fayanzura kayfa ta'maloon
Wa laqad akhadhnaa aala fir'awna bis-sineena wa naqsin minath-thamaraati la-allahum yadhdhakkaroon
Fa-idhaa jaa'athumul-hasanatu qaaloo lanaa haadhihi wa in tusibhum sayyi'atun yattayyaroo bimoosaa wa man ma'ahu alaa innamaa taa'iruhum indallaahi wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wa qaaloo mahmaa ta'tinaa bihi min aayatin litasharanaa bihaa famaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
Fa-arsalnaa alayhimut-toofaana wal-jaraada wal-qummala wad-dafaadi'a wad-dama aayaatin mufassalaatin fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman mujrimeen
Wa lammaa waqa'a alayhimur-rijzu qaaloo yaa moosad-u lanaa rabbaka bimaa ahida indaka la-in kashafta annar-rijza lanu'minanna laka wa lanursilanna ma'aka banee israa'eel
Falammaa kashafnaa anhumur-rijza ilaa ajalin hum baalighoohu idhaa hum yankuthoon
Fantaqamnaa minhum fa-aghraqnaahum fil-yammi bi-annahum kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wa kaanoo anhaa ghaafileen

Wa awrathnal-qawmal-ladheena kaanoo yustad'afoona mashaariqal-ardi wa maghaaribahal-latee baaraknaa feehaa wa tammat kalimatu rabbikal-husnaa alaa banee israa'eela bimaa sabaroo wa dammarnaa maa kaana yasna'u fir'awnu wa qawmuhu wa maa kaanoo ya'rishoon
Wa jaawaznaa bibanee israa'eelal-bahra fa-ataw alaa qawmin ya'kufoona alaa asnaamin lahum qaaloo yaa moosaj-al lanaa ilahan kamaa lahum aalihatun qaala innakum qawmun tajhaloon
Inna haa'ulaa'i mutabbarun maa hum feehi wa baatilun maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Qaala aghayra Allaahi abgheekum ilahan wa huwa faddalakum alal-aalameen
Wa idh anjaynaakum min aali fir'awna yasoomoonakum soo'al-adhaabi yuqattiloona abnaa'akum wa yastahyoona nisaa'akum wa fee dhaalikum balaa'un min rabbikum azeem

Wa waa'adnaa moosaa thalaatheena laylatan wa atmamnaahaa bi-ashrin fatamma meeqaatu rabbihi arba'eena laylatan wa qaala moosaa li'kheehi haaroona ukhlufnee fee qawmee wa aslih wa laa tattabi sabeelal-mufsideen

Wa lammaa jaa'a moosaa limeeqaatinaa wa kallamahu rabbuhu qaala rabbi arinee anzur ilayka qaala lan taraanee wa lakini unzur ilal-jabali fa-ini istaqarra makaanahu fasawfa taraanee falammaa tajallaa rabbuhu liljabali ja'alahu dakkan wa kharra moosaa sa'iqan falammaa afaaqa qaala subhaanaka tubtu ilayka wa anaa awwalul-mu'mineen
Qaala yaa moosaa innis-tafaytuka alan-naasi birisaalaatee wa bikalaamee fakhudh maa aataytuka wa kun minash-shaakireen
Wa katabnaa lahu fil-alwaahi min kulli shay'in maw'izatan wa tafseelan likulli shay'in fakhudhhaa biquwwatin wa mur qawmaka ya'khudhoo bi-ahsanihaa sa'ureekum daaral-faasiqeen

Sa'asrifu an aayaatiyal-ladheena yatakabbaroona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wa in yaraw kulla aayatin laa yu'minoo bihaa wa in yaraw sabeelar-rushdi laa yattakhidhoohu sabeelan wa in yaraw sabeelal-ghayyi yattakhidhoohu sabeelan dhaalika bi-annahum kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wa kaanoo anhaa ghaafileen
Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wa liqaa'il-aakhirati habitat a'maaluhum hal yujzawna illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wattakhadha qawmu moosaa min ba'dihi min huliyyihim ijlan jasadan lahu khuwaarun alam yaraw annahu laa yukallimuhum wa laa yahdeehim sabeelan ittakhadhoohu wa kaanoo zaalimeen
Wa lammaa suqita fee aydeehim wa ra'aw annahum qad dalloo qaaloo la-in lam yarhamnaa rabbunaa wa yaghfir lanaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen

Wa lammaa raja'a moosaa ilaa qawmihi ghadbaana asifan qaala bi'samaa khalaftumoonee min ba'dee a'ajiltum amra rabbikum wa alqal-alwaaha wa akhadha bira'si akheehi yajurruhu ilayhi qaalab-na umma innal-qawma istad'afoonee wa kaadoo yaqtuloonanee falaa tushmit biyal-a'daa'a wa laa taj'alnee ma'al-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Qaala rabbi ighfir lee wa li-akhee wa adkhilnaa fee rahmatika wa anta arhamur-raahimeen
Innal-ladheena ittakhadhul-ijla sayanaaluhum ghadabun min rabbihim wa dhillatun fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa kadhalika najzil-muftareen
Wal-ladheena amilus-sayyi'aati thumma taaboo min ba'dihaa wa aamanoo inna rabbaka min ba'dihaa laghafoorun Raheem
Wa lammaa sakata an moosal-ghadabu akhadhal-alwaaha wa fee nuskhatihaa hudan wa rahmatun lilladheena hum lirabbihim yarhaboon

Wakhtaara moosaa qawmahu sab'eena rajulan limeeqaatinaa falammaa akhadhathumur-rajfatu qaala rabbi law shi'ta ahlaktahum min qablu wa iyyaaya atuhlikunaa bimaa fa-alas-sufahaa'u minnaa in hiya illaa fitnatuka tudillu bihaa man tashaa'u wa tahdee man tashaa'u anta waliyyunaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa anta khayrul-ghaafireen

Waktub lanaa fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati innaa hudnaa ilayka qaala adhaabee useebu bihi man ashaa'u wa rahmatee wasi'at kulla shay'in fasa'aktubuhaa lilladheena yattaqoona wa yu'toonaz-zakaata wal-ladheena hum bi-aayaatinaa yu'minoon

Al-ladheena yattabi'oonar-rasoolan-nabiyyal-ummiyyal-ladhee yajidoonahu maktooban indahum fit-tawraati wal-injeeli ya'muruhum bil-ma'roofi wa yanhaahum anil-munkari wa yuhillu lahumut-tayyibaati wa yuharrimu alayhimul-khabaa'itha wa yada'u anhum israhum wal-aghlaalal-latee kaanat alayhim fa-al-ladheena aamanoo bihi wa azzaroohu wa nasaroohu wattaba'un-nooral-ladhee unzila ma'ahu ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon

Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu innee rasoolullaahi ilaykum jamee'an al-ladhee lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi laa ilaaha illaa huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu fa-aaminoo Billaahi wa rasoolihin-nabiyyil-ummiyyil-ladhee yu'minu Billaahi wa kalimaatihi wattabi'oohu la-allakum tahtadoon
Wa min qawmi moosaa ummatun yahdoona bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'diloon

Wa qatta'naahumu ithnatay ashrata asbaatan umaman wa awhaynaa ilaa moosaa idh istasqaahu qawmuhu anid-rib bi-asaakal-hajara fanbajasat minhu ithnataa ashrata aynan qad alima kullu unaasin mashrabahum wa zallalnaa alayhimul-ghamaama wa anzalnaa alayhimul-manna was-salwaa kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum wa maa zalamoonaa wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Wa idh qeela lahumu uskunoo haadhihil-qaryata wa kuloo minhaa haythu shi'tum wa qooloo hittatun wadkhulul-baaba sujjadan naghfir lakum khatee'aatikum sanazeedul-muhsineen
Fabaddalal-ladheena zalamoo minhum qawlan ghayral-ladhee qeela lahum fa-arsalnaa alayhim rijzan minas-samaa'i bimaa kaanoo yazlimoon

Was'alhum anil-qaryatil-latee kaanat haadiratal-bahri idh ya'doona fis-sabti idh ta'teehim heetaanuhum yawma sabtihim shurra'an wa yawma laa yasbitoona laa ta'teehim kadhaalika nabloohum bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
Wa idh qaalat ummatun minhum lima ta'izoona qawman Allaahu muhlikuhum aw mu'adhdhibuhum adhaaban shadeedan qaaloo ma'dhiratan ilaa rabbikum wa la-allahum yattaqoon
Falammaa nasoo maa dhukkiroo bihi anjaynal-ladheena yanhawna anis-soo'i wa akhadhnal-ladheena zalamoo bi-adhaabin ba'eesin bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
Falammaa ataw an maa nuhoo anhu qulnaa lahum koonoo qiradatan khaasi'een
Wa idh ta'adhdhana rabbuka layab'athanna alayhim ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati man yasoomuhum soo'al-adhaabi inna rabbaka lasaree'ul-iqaabi wa innahu laghafoorun Raheem
Wa qatta'naahum fil-ardi umaman minhumus-saalihoona wa minhum doona dhaalika wa balawnaahum bil-hasanaati was-sayyi'aati la-allahum yarji'oon

Fakhalafa min ba'dihim khalfun wa rithul-kitaaba ya'khudhoona arada haadhal-adnaa wa yaqooloona sayughfaru lanaa wa in ya'tihim aradun mithluhu ya'khudhoohu alam yu'ukhadh alayhim meethaaqul-kitaabi an laa yaqooloo alaa Allaahi illal-haqqa wa darasoo maa feehi wad-daarul-aakhiratu khayrun lilladheena yattaqoona afalaa ta'qiloon
Wal-ladheena yumassikoona bil-kitaabi wa aqaamus-salaata innaa laa nudee'u ajral-musliheen
Wa idh nataqnal-jabala fawqahum ka'annahu zullatun wa zannoo annahu waaqi'un bihim khudhoo maa aataynaakum biquwwatin wadhkuroo maa feehi la-allakum tattaqoon

Wa idh akhadha rabbuka min banee aadama min zuhoorihim dhurriyyatahum wa ashhadahum alaa anfusihim alastu birabbikum qaaloo balaa shahidnaa an taqooloo yawmal-qiyaamati innaa kunnaa an haadhaa ghaafileen
Aw taqooloo innamaa ashraka aabaa'uunaa min qablu wa kunnaa dhurriyyatan min ba'dihim afatuhlikunaa bimaa fa-alal-mubtiloon
Wa kadhalika nufassilul-aayaati wa la-allahum yarji'oon
Watlu alayhim naba'al-ladhee aataynaahu aayaatinaa fansalakha minhaa fa-atba'ahush-shaytaanu fakaana minal-ghaaween

Wa law shi'naa larafa'naahu bihaa wa laakinnahu akhlada ilal-ardi wattaba'a hawaahu famathaluhu kamathalil-kalbi in tahmil alayhi yalhath aw tatrukhu yalhath dhaalika mathalul-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa faqsusil-qasasa la-allahum yatafakkaroon
Saa'a mathalan al-qawmul-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wa anfusahum kaanoo yazlimoon
Man yahdi Allaahu fahuwal-muhtadee wa man yudlil fa-ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon

Wa laqad dhara'naa lijahannama katheeran minal-jinni wal-insi lahum quloobun laa yafqahoona bihaa wa lahum a'yunun laa yubsiroona bihaa wa lahum aadhaanun laa yasma'oona bihaa ulaa'ika kal-an'aami bal hum adallu ulaa'ika humul-ghaafiloon
Wa Lillaahil-asmaa'ul-husnaa faad'oohu bihaa wa dharul-ladheena yulhidoona fee asmaa'ihi sayujzawna maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa mimman khalaqnaa ummatun yahdoona bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'diloon
Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa sanastadrijuhum min haythu laa ya'lamoon
Wa umlee lahum inna kaydee mateen
Awalam yatafakkaroo maa bisaahibihim min jinnatin in huwa illaa nadheerun mubeen
Awalam yanzuroo fee malakootis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa khalaqa Allaahu min shay'in wa an asaa an yakoona qadiq-taraba ajaluhum fabi'ayyi hadeethin ba'dahu yu'minoon
Man yudlili Allaahu falaa haadiya lahu wa yadharuhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Yas'aloonaka anis-saa'ati ayyaana mursaahaa qul innamaa ilmuhaa inda rabbee laa yujalleehaa liwaqtihaa illaa huwa thaqulat fis-samaawaati wal-ardi laa ta'teekum illaa baghtatan yas'aloonaka ka'annaka hafiyyun anhaa qul innamaa ilmuhaa indallaahi wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon

Qul laa amliku linafsee naf'an wa laa darran illaa maa shaa'a Allaahu wa law kuntu a'lamul-ghayba laastakthartu minal-khayri wa maa massaniyas-soo'u in anaa illaa nadheerun wa basheerun liqawmin yu'minoon

Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min nafsin waahidatin wa ja'ala minhaa zawjahaa liyaskuna ilayhaa falammaa taghashshaahaa hamalat hamlan khafeefan famarrat bihi falammaa athqalat da'awaa Allaaha rabbahumaa la-in aataytanaa saalihan lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
Falammaa aataahumaa saalihan ja'alaa lahu shurakaa'a feemaa aataahumaa fata'aalaa Allaahu ammaa yushrikoon
Ayushrikoona maa laa yakhluqu shay'an wa hum yukhlaqoon
Wa laa yastatee'oona lahum nasran wa laa anfusahum yansuroon
Wa in tad'oohum ilal-hudaa laa yattabi'ookum sawaa'un alaykum ada'awtumoohum am antum saamitoon
Innal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi ibaadun amthaalukum faad'oohum falyastajeeboo lakum in kuntum saadiqeen
Alahum arjulun yamshoona bihaa am lahum aydin yabtishoona bihaa am lahum a'yunun yubsiroona bihaa am lahum aadhaanun yasma'oona bihaa qulid-oo shurakaa'akum thumma keedooni falaa tunziroon
Inna waliyyiya Allaahul-ladhee nazzalal-kitaaba wa huwa yatawallas-saaliheen
Wal-ladheena tad'oona min doonihi laa yastatee'oona nasrakum wa laa anfusahum yansuroon
Wa in tad'oohum ilal-hudaa laa yasma'oo wa taraahum yanzuroona ilayka wa hum laa yubsiroon
Khudhil-afwa wa mur bil-urfi wa a'rid anil-jaahileen
Wa immaa yanzaghannaka minash-shaytaani nazghun fasta'idh Billaahi innahu samee'un aleem
Innal-ladheena ittaqaw idhaa massahum taa'ifun minash-shaytaani tadhakkaroo fa-idhaa hum mubsiroon
Wa ikhwaanuhum yamuddoonahum fil-ghayyi thumma laa yuqsiroon
Wa idhaa lam ta'tihim bi-aayatin qaaloo lawlaa ijtabaytahaa qul innamaa attabi'u maa yoohaa ilayya min rabbee haadhaa basaa'iru min rabbikum wa hudan wa rahmatun liqawmin yu'minoon
Wa idhaa quri'al-qur'aanu fastami'oo lahu wa ansitoo la-allakum turhamoon
Wadhkur rabbaka fee nafsika tadarru'an wa kheefatan wa doonal-jahri minal-qawli bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaali wa laa takun minal-ghaafileen
Innal-ladheena inda rabbika laa yastakbiroona an ibaadatihi wa yusabbihoonahu wa lahu yasjudoon
